subject: QuantifyAI — dedicated capacity: quantized slab pricing & next steps
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@quantify.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QuantifyAI — dedicated capacity: quantized slab pricing & next steps

Hi Amy — thanks again for the call today. Quick written recap and a small set of asks so we can get a pilot quote over to procurement.

Call summary (short):
- Workload: real‑time summarization + semantic search on internal docs; average prompt length ~300 tokens, replies ~120 tokens.
- Expected steady-state monthly consumption: 700M - 1.2B tokens/mo depending on compression/QA.
- Peak windows: ~3x baseline over 30–45 minute bursts (concurrent user spikes).
- Target latency: sub‑300 ms per token for tail p95 on user-facing flows.

Unit economics and preference notes from the call:
- Target unit price: you mentioned $50/1M tokens as a preferred anchor; you also said budget could flex up to $75/1M with stronger SLAs. Please confirm a target range.
- Hardware: your infra lead prefers H100 (80GB) for initial pilots but noted cost sensitivity; we discussed quantized 4-bit variants that can make A100v4 a viable lower‑cost option.
- Reserved capacity ask: we discussed options between a 2–4 GPU reserved pilot vs an 8 GPU committed band depending on the monthly token commitment.
- Throughput target: based on profiling, an H100 (quantized model) maps to ~90k–130k tokens/sec sustained depending on batching; we used 110k tokens/sec as a planning number per GPU in the workbook.

Attached: QuantifyAI_token_modeling_v1.xlsx (token scenarios + cost worksheet). I also attached an initial redwood_dedicated_quote.pdf with ballpark bands (no signature).

Asks / next steps:
1) Confirm target $/1M token band (e.g., $40–60, $60–80) so we can pick the right reserved SKU mix.
2) Confirm preferred GPU (H100 vs A100v4) or if you want both options in the quote.
3) Tell us procurement timing / PO window and procurement contact (happy to include a short SOW + 6‑month pilot pricing).

If you want, we can propose a 6‑week canary (2 H100‑equiv reserved lanes with quantized weights) that benchmarks your peak bursts and gives a true per‑1M token anchor.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com | +1 415‑555‑0132

--
Attachment: QuantifyAI_token_modeling_v1.xlsx (token scenarios workbook)
Attachment: redwood_dedicated_quote.pdf (ballpark pricing bands)

From: Amy Chen <amy@quantify.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: QuantifyAI Procurement <procurement@quantify.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantifyAI — dedicated capacity: quantized slab pricing & next steps

Hi Sofia — thanks for the recap and the workbook. Quick answers from our side:

1) Target unit price: our finance lead is aiming for ~ $50/1M tokens as a primary target. If the SLA and throughput guarantees help reduce ops risk we could stretch closer to $65/1M, but $50 is the internal anchor.
2) GPU preference: we prefer H100 if that is materially better for latency. If the A100v4 quantized path can hit your throughput numbers and materially lower the cost, we are open to it — please include both.
3) Procurement timeline: we have a 30–45 day procurement window for pilots. Procurement contact is procurement@quantify.ai (CC'd) — they'll need a line item quote and SOC2 evidence.

We'd be interested in the 6‑week pilot you proposed; ideally the pilot would cost <= $60k total for the period. Can you provide a pilot band that fits that ceiling?

Best,
Amy
Amy Chen
CTO, QuantifyAI
amy@quantify.ai

--

Amy — looping in the pricing side and a concise set of options that map to the $/1M anchors you mentioned. I kept this short; the attached PDF has the full band math.

Pilot proposal (6 weeks):
Option A — Small pilot (cost target: ~$55k total)
- Config: 2 H100‑equivalent reserved lanes (quantized model)
- Throughput: planning 110k tokens/sec per lane (sustained burst handling)
- Expected measured tokens in pilot: 200–350M (depends on usage during window)
- Price: pilot bundle priced at $55k incl. monitoring + 1 week of integration support.

Option B — More conservative pilot (cost target: ~$95k total)
- Config: 4 H100‑equiv reserved lanes (better headroom for spikes)
- Throughput: same per GPU; 4x capacity reduces risk of throttling during bursts
- Price: pilot bundle priced at $95k (includes extra PCIe profiling and 2 weeks support).

Commitment bands (annualized unit econ examples if you convert to a 12‑month commit):
- 0.8B tokens/mo commit: ~ $72/1M tokens (A100 mix)
- 1.2B tokens/mo commit: ~ $58/1M tokens (H100 + quantized slab)
- 2.5B tokens/mo commit: ~ $45/1M tokens (discounted lane/higher utilization)

Notes:
- Pricing above is sensitive to quantization (4‑bit vs 8‑bit) and whether we can use prefix caching for large shared contexts. The workbook shows sensitivity per 1M tokens.
- We can make an H100‑only pilot quote vs an A100v4 (quantized) comparison side‑by‑side; I'll attach that to the formal quote PDF.

Next steps to get you a procurement‑ready packet:
1) Sofia: confirm which pilot option (A or B) to price formally and whether we should include an A100v4 alternative.
2) QuantifyAI: procurement to send standard PO template or billing contact.
3) We will produce a 1‑page SOW + a formal quote (PDF) and SOC2 attestation link.

I'll push a redwood_dedicated_quote.pdf (formalized) to the Drive link and share a DocuSign envelope once we have the PO contact.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
